title: I Sought Him Whom My Soul Loves

questions.question: On my bed by night I sought him whom my soul what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:1 (ESV): "On my bed by night I sought him whom my soul loves;"

questions.question: I will rise now and go about the city, in the streets and in the what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:2 (ESV): "in the streets and in the squares;"

questions.question: Who found the bride as they were going about the city?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:3 (ESV): "The watchmen found me as they went about in the city."

questions.question: What is coming up from the wilderness like columns of smoke?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:6 (ESV): "What is that coming up from the wilderness like columns of smoke," (Context implies Solomon's litter/procession).

questions.question: Behold, it is the litter of whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:7 (ESV): "Behold, it is the litter of Solomon!"

questions.question: When I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:4 (ESV): "I held him, and would not let him go until I had brought him into my mother's house,"

questions.question: How many mighty men surround Solomon's litter?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:7 (ESV): "Around it are sixty mighty men,"

questions.question: King Solomon made himself a carriage from the wood of where?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:9 (ESV): "King Solomon made himself a carriage from the wood of Lebanon."

questions.question: He made its posts of silver, its back of what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:10 (ESV): "He made its posts of silver, its back of gold,"

questions.question: Go out, O daughters of Zion, and look upon King whom?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:11 (ESV): "Go out, O daughters of Zion, and look upon King Solomon,"

questions.question: Scarcely had I passed them when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him and brought him into whose house?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:4 (ESV): "until I had brought him into my mother's house,"

questions.question: The columns of smoke are perfumed with myrrh and what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:6 (ESV): "perfumed with myrrh and frankincense,"

questions.question: All of the mighty men wearing swords and expert in what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:8 (ESV): "all wearing swords and expert in war,"

questions.question: Its seat was of purple, its interior was inlaid with what by the daughters of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:10 (ESV): "its interior was inlaid with love by the daughters of Jerusalem."

questions.question: With the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his what?
questions.explanation: Song of Solomon 3:11 (ESV): "on the day of his wedding,"

key_verse_text: Scarcely had I passed them when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her who conceived me.
